byteward.title: Lumora announces the Arc 7 phone
byteward.author: Arlo Pennick
body: [f01: Lumora on Thursday announced the Arc 7, its new flagship phone.] On paper, it's a steady update rather than a reinvention.
[f03: At its center is the Facet 3, the latest chip Lumora designs in-house.] [f02: The display measures 6.4 inches diagonally.] [f04: On the back, the main camera uses a 50-megapixel sensor.]
[f05: Powering it all is a 5,000 mAh battery.] How long that lasts will depend on how efficient the new chip turns out to be.
That makes the Arc 7 a phone to judge in reviews rather than on a spec sheet.

launch-desk.title: Lumora launches the Arc 7 phone
launch-desk.author: Inez Calder
body: [f01: Lumora has launched the Arc 7, its latest flagship phone.] [f06: It costs $799.] [f07: Sales start November 20.]
[f08: The phone will be sold in 14 countries at launch.] [f03: Inside is the Facet 3, Lumora's newest in-house chip.]
At that price, the Arc 7 goes straight at the year's other big flagships, and the new chip will have to carry the pitch.

frametime.title: Lumora's new Arc 7 phone, tested
frametime.author: Kofi Mensah-Lind
body: [f01: Lumora announced the Arc 7 today, its new flagship phone.] We've had one on our bench, so here's how it performs.
[f03: Driving it is the Facet 3, Lumora's newest in-house chip.] [f09: In our multi-core CPU test, the Arc 7 finished 24% ahead of the Arc 6.]
[f10: In Pinefall Arena at maximum settings, it averaged 58 frames per second.] That's smooth enough that you'll rarely notice a hitch.
[f11: Sustained load is another story: after 20 minutes of our stress test, the phone was holding just 71% of its peak speed.] Long gaming sessions will feel that drop.

ohm-and-bit.title: Lumora unveils the Arc 7 flagship phone
ohm-and-bit.author: Rafe Okonkwo-Hart
body: [f03: The Arc 7 is built around the Facet 3, Lumora's newest in-house chip.] [f12: Lumora has it made on a 2 nm process.] A smaller process lets a chip run faster on the same power, but it also packs the heat into a smaller area.

[f13: To spread that heat, the phone uses a vapor chamber 30 percent larger than the Arc 6's.] [f11: It helps, up to a point: in our 20-minute stress test, the Arc 7 settled at 71 percent of its peak performance.]

[f05: The battery is a 5,000 mAh cell.] [f14: Instead of glue, a screwed-in bracket holds it in place, so it comes out with a standard screwdriver.] That bracket takes up space a bigger cell could have used, a trade-off we think most owners will be glad to make.

bench-and-bill.title: Lumora announces the Arc 7 phone, with a repair plan attached
bench-and-bill.author: Owen Brightwater
body: [f01: Lumora announced the Arc 7 on Thursday, the newest phone in its flagship line.] [f15: The same day, it filed a repair plan for the phone under the Parts and Manuals Act.]
[f16: In the filing, Lumora commits to selling spare parts for the Arc 7 for seven years.] [f17: Repair manuals will be free to download from the day the phone goes on sale.]
[f14: The plan also says the battery can be removed with a standard screwdriver.] Independent repair shops will be watching to see whether the parts actually show up.

wirefold.title: Lumora unveils Arc 7 flagship phone
body: Phone maker Lumora on Thursday unveiled the Arc 7, a $799 flagship built around its new in-house Facet 3 chip. The phone goes on sale Nov. 20.
